title: Persona-Claude-Native front-matter schema (axis-A input)
description: Schema for the YAML front-matter block of a .claude/agents/<slug>.md persona-definition file as authored against the Claude-Code spawner contract. Sprint-Pengine-7 Tag-1 documents the production input shape of the 13 active personae. The Markdown body is NOT covered by this schema and is treated as out-of-hash by V-907 (mirrored here as out-of-schema). Per the persona-engine-format-spec.md v1.0 §2, the front-matter is the lossless source for the wakir-persona-v1 conversion target.

name.description: Subagent slug. Brand-Guide §9 anonymity contract: never a clear personal name.

description.description: Spawn-time dispatcher hint. Free-form, may be multi-paragraph.

tools.description: Claude-Code tool allow-list. Accepted as comma-separated string for ergonomics or as an explicit array of strings. Mutually-recommended-exclusive with 'model' (one or the other typically; both is permitted but discouraged).

model.description: Claude-Code model override (e.g. 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku'). When present without a 'tools' key, the spawner uses the default tool set for that model. The hr.md persona exemplifies this shape.
